scope: Run every practical post-challenge backtest expansion route, without limiting the demo to earnings, EPS, equities, or the frozen competition protocol.
allowed_for_demo: change traded object from equity/security return to prediction-market contract return
rank routes by maximum presentable N and engineering demonstrability
use repository-first offline scans and optional online probes
publish route scorecards, candidate manifests and funnel diagnostics
not_allowed: claim validated equity alpha from contract-PnL routes
hide that the route universe changed
mix terminal outcomes into signal construction
claim deployability without separate out-of-sample, fees, liquidity and capacity controls
primary_objective: Find and materialize the largest defensible presentation/demo backtest path across all available universes.
